Alex (Support): Heads-up: onboarding webhook failures affecting ~30 trial accounts in the EU region since 02:00 UTC. Some accounts show activation stuck "pending verification".
Rina (CS): Any high-value or renewals inside 30 days?
Alex (Support): Two renewals flagged: SlateOps (renewal in 21d) and MediFuse (renewal in 9d). Activity drop in cohort +12% conversion loss.
Ethan (Solutions): Paste minimal error: 
```
422 Unprocessable Entity - signature mismatch
{"expected":"sha256=...","received":"sha256=..."}
```
Alex (Support): Workaround: reissue webhook secret in Console -> re-register endpoint; validated for 6 customers.
Rina (CS): Proposed plan: (1) Solutions hotfix + canary 4h, (2) CS outreach to renewal owners + offer trial extension 3d if activation delayed, (3) Support KB + quick script to validate signature, (4) Legal to approve credit wording. Owners: Ethan, Rina, Alex, Nora.
Nora (Legal): Approve wording: "trial extension or account credit at our discretion; contact your CSM". Need exec cc for SlateOps/MediFuse.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-5239 created; bridge -> #eng-runtime.
Ethan (Solutions): Spinning canary now. Will report RCA or mitigation in ~90m.
Rina (CS): I'll draft outreach copy and post here. If any cancellation or downgrade language appears, tag me immediately.
Alex (Support): Will publish KB and include a 2-question survey. Will update thread with live customer replies.
